_meta.scope: Hand-maintained resort-level centroids for the Live Conditions Dashboard's nearest-resort geolocation match and for the Resorts tab's overview list. Covers all thirteen Portes du Soleil resorts, including Roc d'Enfer St Jean d'Aulps — a self-contained 16-lift/32-piste sub-domain (Saint-Jean-d'Aulps + La Chèvrerie sectors) that IS fully routable in data/network.json, just not lift-linked to the rest of Portes du Soleil, so routes never cross between it and the main network. `slug` doubles as the open-piste resort slug where open-piste has a matching entry — as of 2026-08, that's avoriaz, morzine, chatel, les-gets, chapelle-abondance, abondance, torgon and st-jean-aulps; open-piste has no record at all for morgins, champoussin, les-crosets, val-dilliez or champery, so those resorts only ever show live Open-Meteo weather, with avalanche risk reported as unavailable rather than guessed.
